title.zh: 小测：土壤、侵蚀和分水岭

intro.en: Read each question twice. Watch for traps!

canNow.en: I can now answer questions on soil, erosion and divides.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以回答关于土壤、侵蚀和分水岭的问题。

questions.q: Soil is a mixture of...
options: rock pieces, minerals and organic matter

why.en: Soil has rock pieces, minerals and organic matter (plus water and air).
why.zh: 土壤有岩石碎块、矿物和有机物（还有水和空气）。

questions.q: Humus comes from...

why.en: Bacteria and fungi break down dead plants and animals into humus.
why.zh: 细菌和真菌把死去的植物和动物分解成腐殖质。

questions.q: Which horizon is topsoil?

why.en: Topsoil is Horizon A, under the O layer of leaves.
why.zh: 表土是 A 层，在 O 层（落叶层）下面。

questions.q: Which horizon is mostly pieces of weathered rock?

why.en: Horizon C is at the bottom: pieces of weathered rock.
why.zh: C 层在最下面：风化的岩石碎块。

questions.q: Erosion means...
options: dropping rock and soil in a new place

why.en: Erosion takes away. Deposition drops. Trap: do not mix them up!
why.zh: 侵蚀是带走，沉积是放下。陷阱：别搞混！

questions.q: A river drops its sediment where it meets the ocean. This makes a...

why.en: A delta forms at the river mouth, like the Mississippi River delta.
why.zh: 三角洲在河口形成，比如密西西比河三角洲。

questions.q: Wind erosion is greatest in...

why.en: Deserts have little water to hold soil and few trees to block the wind.
why.zh: 沙漠里水少，留不住土；树少，挡不住风。

questions.q: What is the force under ALL erosion and deposition?

why.en: Gravity makes water and ice move downhill and makes particles settle.
why.zh: 重力让水和冰往下流，也让颗粒沉下来。

questions.q: A divide is...
options: a deep hole in the sea
a line of high land where water runs down one side or the other

why.en: Rain on a divide runs down one side or the other.
why.zh: 落在分水岭上的雨从一边或另一边流下。

questions.q: Water from the EAST slopes of the Rocky Mountains runs toward the...

why.en: West slopes: Pacific Ocean. East slopes: Gulf of Mexico.
why.zh: 西坡流向太平洋，东坡流向墨西哥湾。

intro.en: Tap the word that fits. Think: count it? compare? to me or away?
intro.zh: 点出合适的词。想一想：能数吗？比较吗？拿来还是拿走？

canNow.en: I can now choose bring/take, fewer/less, than/then, accept/except.

items.text: Please ___ your book here to me.

why.en: Toward the speaker (to me): bring.

items.text: Don't forget to ___ your umbrella when you go to school.

why.en: Away from home: take.

items.text: There were ___ students in class today because of the rain.

why.en: You can count students: fewer.

items.text: I drink ___ milk than my brother.

why.en: You cannot count milk: less.
Comparing two people: than.

items.text: We ate lunch, and ___ we went swimming.

why.en: What happened next (time): then.

items.text: Emma was happy to ___ the gift from her friend.

why.en: Take it and say yes: accept.

items.text: Everyone came to the party ___ James, who was ill.

why.en: But not James: except.

items.text: The bus had ___ left when we got to the stop.

why.en: Before now: already (one word).

items.text: The cat sat ___ the two chairs.

why.en: Two things: between.

title.en: Quiz: Earth History and Ocean Floor

intro.en: Read each question twice. Watch for traps!

canNow.en: I can now answer questions on rock layers and the ocean floor.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以回答关于岩层和海底的问题。

questions.q: Earth formed about...

why.en: Billion, not million: about 4.6 billion years.
why.zh: 是十亿不是百万：大约 46 亿年。

questions.q: Uniformitarianism says...
options: the processes changing Earth today also changed it in the past
all rocks are the same age

why.en: Uniform means same: same processes, then and now.
why.zh: uniform 是“相同”：过去和现在是同样的过程。

questions.q: By the principle of superposition, the OLDEST layer is usually...

why.en: Lower layers formed first, so they are older (unless disturbed).
why.zh: 下面的层先形成，所以更老（除非被扰动过）。

questions.q: Magma cuts through four rock layers. The magma is...
options: the same age as the top layer

why.en: Cross-cutting: the layers had to be there first.
why.zh: 切割关系：岩层必须先存在。

questions.q: An unconformity is a place where...

why.en: Uplift and erosion removed some layers.
why.zh: 抬升和侵蚀磨掉了一些岩层。

questions.q: The continental shelf is...
options: the gentle part nearest the shore

why.en: Shelf = gentle, near the shore, up to about 150 to 200 m deep.
why.zh: 大陆架 = 平缓，靠近海岸，水深最多约 150 到 200 米。

questions.q: Which part of the margin is steep and goes down to about 4000 m?

why.en: The slope drops steeply. Submarine canyons cut into it.
why.zh: 大陆坡陡峭下降，海底峡谷切进去。

questions.q: A passive margin, like the east coast of North America, has...
options: a wide shelf and no plate boundary nearby
a narrow shelf and a trench
a mid-ocean ridge on the beach

why.en: Passive = no plate boundary = wide shelf (100 km or more).
why.zh: 被动 = 没有板块边界 = 宽大陆架（100 千米或更多）。

questions.q: Deep-sea trenches form where...
options: ocean crust dives under continental crust

why.en: Trenches are at convergent boundaries. Ridges are at divergent ones (trap!).
why.zh: 海沟在汇聚边界，洋中脊在离散边界（陷阱！）。

questions.q: Mid-ocean ridges are about how long?

why.en: They are Earth's longest continuous mountain range.
why.zh: 它们是地球上最长的连续山脉。

intro.en: Use the "say it in full" test: you're = you are, it's = it is.
intro.zh: 用“展开说”检查法：you're = you are，it's = it is。

canNow.en: I can now fix your/you're, their/they're, its/it's and more.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以改正 your/you're、their/they're、its/it's 等错误。

questions.q: Choose the correct word: ___ coat is on the chair.

why.en: Belongs to you: your. You're = you are.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: ___ going to the beach tomorrow.

why.en: They are going: they're.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: The dog wagged ___ tail.

why.en: Belongs to it: its. It's = it is.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: ___ the girl singing on stage?

why.en: Who is: who's.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: Sophie ___ to live in London.

why.en: A past habit: used to.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: James ate ___ orange.

why.en: Orange starts with a vowel sound: an.

questions.q: Which is correct?
options: Take the box off of the table.
Take the box off the table.
Take the box of off the table.
Take the box offen the table.

why.en: Write off, not "off of".

questions.q: Which is correct?
options: Their are a lot of pandas here.
There are allot of pandas here.
There are alot of pandas here.
There are a lot of pandas here.

why.en: A lot is two words. There = a place / there are.
why.zh: a lot 是两个词。there are = 有。

questions.q: Which is correct?

why.en: A long way, not "a long ways".
why.zh: a long way，不是 a long ways。

questions.q: Which is correct?

why.en: This book, not "this here book".
why.zh: this book，不是 this here book。

title.zh: 作业：土壤、侵蚀和分水岭

intro.en: Read Main Book S1 to S3 first. Then do this ONCE.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 S1 到 S3，再做一次。

canNow.en: I can now answer soil, erosion and divide questions on my own.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以自己回答土壤、侵蚀和分水岭的问题。

questions.q: Soil horizons from TOP to bottom are...

why.en: O (leaves), A (topsoil), B (subsoil), C (weathered rock).
why.zh: O（落叶）、A（表土）、B（底土）、C（风化岩石）。

questions.q: Which part of soil is organic?

why.en: Organic = made by living things. Humus comes from dead plants and animals.
why.zh: 有机 = 由生物形成。腐殖质来自死去的动植物。

questions.q: Iron and aluminum compounds washed down by rainwater collect in...

why.en: Rainwater washes minerals down from A into B.
why.zh: 雨水把矿物从 A 层冲到 B 层。

questions.q: A mature soil has how many horizons?

why.en: Mature soil has four horizons. Younger soil has fewer.
why.zh: 成熟土壤有四层，年轻土壤更少。

questions.q: Rainwater running off land leaves an eroded path called a...

why.en: A gully can grow into a stream or river.
why.zh: 冲沟可以变成溪流或河。

questions.q: Deposition means...
options: dropping sediment in a new place

why.en: Deposition builds land in a new place.
why.zh: 沉积让新的地方土地变多。

questions.q: Sand dunes are built when...
options: the wind slows down and drops sand

why.en: Slow wind cannot carry its load, so it drops the sand.
why.zh: 风变慢带不动，就把沙子放下。

questions.q: Glaciers can...

why.en: Glaciers move boulders and carve valleys over time.
why.zh: 冰川推动巨石，时间久了刻出山谷。

questions.q: Drainage basin means the same as...

why.en: The Word Watch says drainage basin and watershed mean the same.
why.zh: 词语小贴士说 drainage basin 和 watershed 意思一样。

questions.q: Water from the WEST slopes of the Appalachian Mountains flows into the...

why.en: Appalachians: west to the Gulf of Mexico, east to the Atlantic.
why.zh: 阿巴拉契亚山脉：西边流向墨西哥湾，东边流向大西洋。

intro.en: Read Main Book E1 first. Then do this ONCE.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 E1，再做一次。

canNow.en: I can now choose the correct usage word on my own.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以自己选对用法词。

questions.q: (Bring / Take) this letter to the post office, please.

why.en: Away from here: take.

questions.q: There are (fewer / less) cars on the road today.

why.en: Cars can be counted: fewer.

questions.q: Tom runs faster (than / then) Ben.

why.en: Comparing: than.

questions.q: We (could have / could of) won the game.

why.en: Could of is never correct. Write could have.
why.zh: could of 永远是错的，要写 could have。

questions.q: Share the sweets (between / among) the five children.

why.en: Five children = more than two: among.

questions.q: Mia wanted to know (why / how come) the shop was closed.

why.en: In writing: why.

questions.q: The story (that / where) we read was about a fox.

why.en: A story is not a place: that.

questions.q: Is everything (all right / allright)?

why.en: All right is two words.

questions.q: Emma (teaches / learns) her little brother to swim.

why.en: Emma shows him how: teaches.

questions.q: The puppy wagged (its / it's) tail.

why.en: Belongs to it: its.

title.en: Homework: Rock Layers and Ocean Floor

intro.en: Read Main Book S4 to S6 first. Then do this ONCE.
intro.zh: 先读主课本 S4 到 S6，再做一次。

canNow.en: I can now answer rock layer and ocean floor questions on my own.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以自己回答岩层和海底的问题。

questions.q: Who wrote Theory of the Earth in 1795?

why.en: James Hutton, a Scottish geologist.
why.zh: 苏格兰地质学家詹姆斯·赫顿。

questions.q: Uplift means...

why.en: Uplift raises land up. Weathering and erosion wear it down.
why.zh: 抬升让土地升高，风化和侵蚀把它磨低。

questions.q: Sedimentary rock forms when layers of sediment are...

why.en: Compacted (pressed) and cemented (stuck) together.

questions.q: Layer 1 is at the bottom and layer 3 is at the top. Which is the youngest?

why.en: Superposition: the top layer is the youngest.
why.zh: 叠置原理：最上面的层最年轻。

questions.q: "Super" in superposition means...

why.en: Word Watch: super = above, position = where something is.
why.zh: 词语小贴士：super = 在上面，position = 位置。

questions.q: A cutaway view of the rocks in one place is called a...

why.en: Like cutting a layer cake to see inside.
why.zh: 像切开千层蛋糕看里面。

questions.q: The continental rise is covered by...
options: sediment from the shelf and slope

why.en: Sediment drifted down and settled at the bottom of the slope.
why.zh: 沉积物飘下来，堆在大陆坡底部。

questions.q: An active margin, like the west coast of North America, often has...
options: a narrow shelf, trenches, volcanoes and earthquakes
a very wide shelf and no earthquakes

why.en: Active = plate boundary nearby.
why.zh: 主动 = 附近有板块边界。

questions.q: Deep-sea trenches are...

why.en: Trenches are the deepest parts of the ocean.
why.zh: 海沟是海洋最深的地方。

questions.q: Mid-ocean ridges form at...
options: divergent boundaries, where plates move apart

why.en: Diverge = move apart.

intro.en: Read the word, say what it means, then tap to check.
intro.zh: 读词，说出意思，再点卡片检查。

cards.back: What the air is like today: hot or cold, wet or dry, windy or calm.
cards.zhBack: 今天空气的样子：冷热、干湿、有没有风。

cards.back: The usual weather of a place over many years.
cards.zhBack: 一个地方很多年来通常的天气。

cards.back: The layer of air around Earth.
A huge body of air with the same temperature and wetness all through.
cards.zhBack: 温度和湿度都差不多的一大团空气。

cards.back: Hot: made near the equator.
Cold: made near the poles.
Wet: made over the ocean.
Dry: made over land.
The line where two different air masses meet.
cards.zhBack: 两种不同气团相遇的地方。

cards.back: Cold air pushes under warm air fast, like a bulldozer: sudden storms.
cards.zhBack: 冷空气像推土机一样快速钻到暖空气下面：突然的暴风雨。

cards.back: Warm air slides slowly up over cold air, like a ramp: gentle rain for a long time.
cards.zhBack: 暖空气像走斜坡一样慢慢滑到冷空气上面：长时间小雨。

cards.back: Water vapour (a gas) turning back into liquid drops.
cards.zhBack: 水蒸气（气体）变回小水滴。

canNow.en: I can now explain 12 weather words.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 12 个天气词汇。

pairs.b: today
many years
wet, over the ocean
dry, over land
hot, near the equator
cold, near the poles
the bulldozer: sudden storms

gas turns into liquid drops

canNow.en: I can now match the weather words.
canNow.zh: 我现在能配对天气词汇。

intro.en: Remember the pictures: the sponge, the bulldozer, the ramp and the cold drink.
intro.zh: 记住这些画面：海绵、推土机、斜坡和冰饮料。

questions.q: "It is raining in Bangkok today." This is...

why.en: Today = weather.

questions.q: "Deserts get very little rain every year." This is...

why.en: Many years = climate.

questions.q: An air mass that formed over a warm ocean is...

why.en: Ocean = maritime (wet). Warm = tropical.

questions.q: Continental polar air is...

why.en: Continental = dry. Polar = cold.
why.zh: 大陆的 = 干；极地的 = 冷。

questions.q: Which air sinks?

why.en: Cold air is heavy, so it sinks.

questions.q: A cold front is like a...

why.en: Cold air shoves warm air up fast.
why.zh: 冷空气把暖空气快速推上去。

questions.q: Gentle rain for a long time usually comes with a...

why.en: Warm air slides up slowly: flat clouds, gentle rain.
why.zh: 暖空气慢慢滑上去：平平的云，小雨。

questions.q: Water drops on the outside of a cold drink are caused by...

why.en: Water vapour in the air cools and turns into liquid.
why.zh: 空气里的水蒸气变冷，变成液体。

questions.q: Clouds form when warm, wet air...

why.en: High up it is cold, so water vapour condenses into tiny drops.
why.zh: 高空很冷，水蒸气凝结成小水滴。

questions.q: Puffy, cotton-ball clouds are...

why.en: Cumulus = puffy. Stratus = flat. Cirrus = wispy.
why.zh: 积云 = 蓬松；层云 = 平；卷云 = 细丝。

canNow.en: I can now explain air masses, fronts and how clouds form.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释气团、锋和云的形成。

title.zh: 星期六作业：方程和校对

intro.en: Maths first: undo it, then check. Then the sound-alike words. One try only.
intro.zh: 先做数学：抵消，再检查。然后做发音相似的词。只能做一次。

questions.q: 7r = 56. What is r?

why.en: Undo × 7 with ÷ 7: r = 56 ÷ 7 = 8. Check: 7 × 8 = 56.

questions.q: n ÷ 4 = 9. What is n?

why.en: Undo ÷ 4 with × 4: n = 9 × 4 = 36. Check: 36 ÷ 4 = 9.

questions.q: 6x = 42. What is x?
y ÷ 5 = 12. What is y?
3/5 s = 9. What is s?

why.en: 3 parts = 9, so 1 part = 3. All 5 parts: s = 5 × 3 = 15. Check: 3/5 of 15 = 9.

questions.q: 2/3 m = 10. What is m?

why.en: 2 parts = 10, so 1 part = 5. All 3 parts: m = 3 × 5 = 15.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: ___ going to the park later.

why.en: We are going: we're.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: I can't find ___ shoes.

why.en: My comes before a noun: my shoes.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: The team lost ___ match.

why.en: Belongs to it: its. It's = it is.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: ___ is your bag? It's over ___.

why.en: Where = which place. There = that place.

canNow.en: I can now solve × and ÷ equations and pick the right sound-alike word.
canNow.zh: 我现在会解乘除方程，并会选对发音相似的词。

title.en: Sunday Homework: Earth Science Review (S1 to S6)
title.zh: 星期天作业：地球科学复习（S1 到 S6）

intro.en: Look at your Main Book if you need to. One try only.
intro.zh: 需要的话看主课本。只能做一次。

questions.q: Soil is a mixture of...
options: rock pieces, minerals, organic matter, water and air

why.en: Soil is a mixture of all of these.
why.zh: 土壤是这些东西的混合物。

questions.q: The top layer of leaves and twigs is Horizon...

why.en: O = organic layer on top.
why.zh: O 层 = 最上面的有机层。

questions.q: Erosion means...

why.en: Erosion takes away. Deposition drops.
why.zh: 侵蚀是带走，沉积是放下。

questions.q: A delta forms where a river...
options: meets the ocean and drops its sediment

why.en: The river slows down at the ocean and drops sediment.
why.zh: 河流到海边变慢，放下沉积物。

questions.q: A divide is...
options: high land where water runs down one side or the other

why.en: Rain on a divide flows one way or the other.
why.zh: 落在分水岭上的雨会流向一边或另一边。

questions.q: Superposition: in undisturbed rock layers, the OLDEST layer is...

why.en: It was laid down first.

questions.q: Magma cuts through rock layers. The magma is...

why.en: Cross-cutting: the layers had to be there first.

questions.q: An unconformity shows that...

why.en: Erosion removed some layers.

questions.q: Going out from the beach, the order is...

why.en: Shelf first (shallow), then down the slope, the rise and the flat abyssal plain.
why.zh: 先是大陆架（浅），然后大陆坡、大陆隆和平坦的深海平原。

questions.q: Mid-ocean ridges form where plates...

why.en: Divergent boundary = plates move apart.
why.zh: 离散边界 = 板块分开。

canNow.en: I can now remember soil, erosion, rock layers and the ocean floor.
canNow.zh: 我现在记得土壤、侵蚀、岩层和海底。

title.en: Day 1 Maths: Undo It! × and ÷ Equations
title.zh: 第 1 天数学：乘除方程

items.q: Solve 5k = 35. What happens to k? What is the opposite? Answer and check.

why.en: k is multiplied by 5, so divide both sides by 5: 35 ÷ 5 = 7.
why.zh: k 被乘以 5，所以两边除以 5：35 ÷ 5 = 7。

items.q: Solve y ÷ 3 = 8. What happens to y? What is the opposite? Answer and check.

why.en: y is divided by 3, so multiply both sides by 3: 8 × 3 = 24.
why.zh: y 被除以 3，所以两边乘以 3：8 × 3 = 24。

items.q: Solve 9p = 72. What happens to p? What is the opposite? Answer and check.

why.en: p is multiplied by 9, so divide both sides by 9: 72 ÷ 9 = 8.
why.zh: p 被乘以 9，所以两边除以 9：72 ÷ 9 = 8。

items.q: Solve w ÷ 6 = 7. What happens to w? What is the opposite? Answer and check.

why.en: w is divided by 6, so multiply both sides by 6: 7 × 6 = 42.
why.zh: w 被除以 6，所以两边乘以 6：7 × 6 = 42。

items.q: Solve 12a = 144. What happens to a? What is the opposite? Answer and check.

why.en: a is multiplied by 12, so divide both sides by 12: 144 ÷ 12 = 12.
Do the opposite of ÷ 5: 11 × 5 = 55.

items.q: Emma pays 60 baht for 4 notebooks. Which equation finds the price p of one?

why.en: 4 notebooks × p baht = 60 baht. (Then p = 15 baht.)
why.zh: 4 本 × p 泰铢 = 60 泰铢。（所以 p = 15 泰铢。）

items.q: Tom solved 7r = 56 and wrote r = 392. What did he do wrong?
items.right: B) He multiplied by 7. He should divide.

why.en: 56 × 7 = 392. The opposite of × 7 is ÷ 7, so r = 56 ÷ 7 = 8.

options: B) He multiplied by 7. He should divide.

title.zh: 第 1 天英语：单词分类

items.q: Which words go in the Sea and Animals group?

why.en: They are about the sea or animals.
why.zh: 它们和海洋或动物有关。

items.q: Which words go in the People and Feelings group?

why.en: They describe people and how they feel.

items.q: Which words go in the Science and Numbers group?
items.right: ecologist, dissolve, classify, disruption, billion, neurons

why.en: They are science or number words.
why.zh: 它们是科学或数字的词。

items.q: A perplexing maths problem makes you feel...

why.en: Perplexing = confusing.

items.q: Sugar ________ in hot tea.

why.en: Dissolve = mix into a liquid and disappear.

items.q: Which animal can have venom?

why.en: Some snakes make venom (poison).

items.q: How many zeros are in one billion (1,000,000,000)?

why.en: Count them: 3 + 3 + 3 = 9.

items.q: Neurons carry messages between...
items.right: A) the brain and the body

why.en: Neurons are nerve cells.

options: A) the brain and the body
B) the sea and the sky
D) a tree and its leaves

items.q: A dolphin in captivity...
items.right: B) lives in a tank and cannot leave

why.en: Captivity = kept somewhere and not allowed to leave.

options: B) lives in a tank and cannot leave
D) is a kind of coral

items.q: Write ONE sentence about yourself with the word "confident".
items.right: Example: I feel confident when I sing in front of my friends.

why.en: Any sentence is fine if it uses confident correctly, starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.
why.zh: 只要正确使用 confident，大写开头、句号结尾，都可以。

title.zh: 第 2 天数学：小数和分数

items.q: 1/4 k = 5. 1 part = 5. k is 4 parts, so k = 4 × 5 = ?

why.en: 1 part is 5, and k is all 4 parts: 4 × 5 = 20. Check: 1/4 of 20 = 5.
12 ÷ 3 = 4, then 4 parts × 4 = 16. Check: 3/4 of 16 = 12.

items.q: 0.5x = 7. 0.5 is a half. Half of x is 7, so x = ?  Check: 0.5 × ? = 7

why.en: Half of x is 7, so x is double 7: 14.
why.zh: x 的一半是 7，所以 x 是 7 的两倍：14。

why.en: Do the opposite of ÷ 2: 4.5 × 2 = 9.
2 parts = 8, so 1 part = 4. h = 5 × 4 = 20.

items.q: Sophie ran 3/4 of a race. She ran 600 m. How long is the whole race?

why.en: 3 parts = 600 m, so 1 part = 200 m. 4 parts = 800 m.

items.q: Jack says the answer to 2/3 n = 12 is n = 8. Is he right?

why.en: 2 parts = 12, so 1 part = 6. n = 3 × 6 = 18. Jack found 2/3 of 12 instead.

title.zh: 第 2 天英语：is 还是 are？

items.q: Emma ________ a confident swimmer.

why.en: Emma = one person: is.

items.q: Sharks ________ saltwater fish.

why.en: Sharks = more than one: are.

items.q: The coral reef ________ full of colour.

why.en: The reef = one thing: is.

items.q: Neurons ________ tiny cells in your body.

why.en: Neurons = more than one: are.

items.q: James and Tom ________ ecologists.

why.en: Two people: are.

items.q: This puzzle ________ so perplexing!

why.en: One puzzle: is.

items.q: There ________ more than a billion people in China.

why.en: The subject is people (more than one): are.

items.q: The box of shells ________ on the table. (Careful!)

why.en: Trap! The subject is the BOX (one): is.

items.q: Which sentence is correct?
items.right: C) The animals in the zoo are in captivity.

why.en: Animals = more than one: are.

options: C) The animals in the zoo are in captivity.

items.q: Which sentence is correct?
items.right: B) Each fish is a different colour.

why.en: Each = one at a time: is.

options: A) Lily and Mia is sisters.
B) Each fish is a different colour.

items.q: Write 2 sentences about your family: one with is, one with are.
items.right: Example: My dad is funny. My cousins are in Beijing.

why.en: One person or thing: is. More than one: are.

title.zh: 第 3 天科学：轻松学天气

items.q: Weather is like your ________; climate is like your ________.

why.en: Weather changes daily like an outfit. Climate is over many years like a wardrobe.
why.zh: 天气每天变，像衣服；气候是多年的，像衣柜。

items.q: "Bangkok is hot and wet for most of the year." This sentence is about...

why.en: "Most of the year" = a long time = climate.
why.zh: “一年中大部分时间” = 长时间 = 气候。

items.q: Why is an air mass like a giant sponge?
items.right: A) It soaks up the heat and wetness of the place it sits over.

why.en: Like a sponge soaks up water.

options: A) It soaks up the heat and wetness of the place it sits over.
B) It is yellow and soft.

items.q: At a cold front, warm air is pushed up...

why.en: The bulldozer pushes warm air up fast.
why.zh: 推土机把暖空气快速推上去。

items.q: A cold front often brings...

why.en: Short, heavy rain and thunderstorms.

items.q: Which comparison matches a warm front?

why.en: Warm air slides gently up like a ramp.
why.zh: 暖空气像走斜坡一样慢慢滑上去。

items.q: Water drops on a cold can of drink are an example of...

why.en: Water vapour turns back into water.

items.q: TEST TIP: Which question word tells you to give a REASON?

why.en: "Explain why" asks for a reason. Use because.
why.zh: Explain why 要求给出原因，用 because。

items.q: Explain why clouds form high in the sky. Use the word "because".
items.right: Example: Clouds form high in the sky because the air cools down and the water vapour condenses into tiny water drops.

why.en: Your answer needs: air cools + water vapour turns into water drops (condensation) + because.
why.zh: 答案要有：空气变冷 + 水蒸气变成小水滴（凝结）+ because。
